gap: Overs and Goblins: L10 average minus the posted line. Unders: line minus L10 average.

bands.short: average is on the wrong side of the line
bands.between: average is past the line and short of the cover unit
bands.clears: average clears the line by at least the cover unit

filter: Goblin OVER, Standard OVER, Standard UNDER. At least 8 of the last 10 games. DNP out. L5=5 is not required. Categories with n under 30 are omitted.
